basic_info.description:
Key Features & Amenities:
- 3 Large Bedrooms 1 Full Bathroom
- Approximately 1500 sq ft of living space
- Washer/dryer in building
- Full backyard access
- 99 Walk Score, 87 Bike Score, 71 Transit
- Walkable to many markets, stores, shops, restaurants, bars & more
- Short distance to GG Park, Mountain Lake Park and The Presidio
- Close by to tech shuttles, Muni lines to downtown/financial district
- Cats and dogs OK
- 12 month lease

-Currently occupied until 12/31/24. Move-in available 1/1/25
-No smoking, no partying
-Tenants to pay their own PG&E bill, water split evenly among all persons in building.
-Recology included. Tenant to pay for Internet.
